title: Declare the corpus and question set as data and refuse an inconsistent one
problem: Every retrieval score is computed against gold passages. If a question points at a passage that does not exist, or two passages share an ID, the scores silently measure the wrong thing, and nobody notices because the harness still prints numbers.
context: This is the first task of a learner-authored forge project. No source exists yet. The learner creates the repository, chooses its structure, and owns every design decision inside the specification's constraints.
impact: The corpus and question set are the population every later measurement is taken over. An inconsistent set makes every later score meaningless.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The corpus (passages with stable IDs and text) and the question set (question text with one or more gold passage IDs) are declared in data files. Adding a question or passage needs no source change.

A question set referencing an unknown passage ID, a duplicate passage or question ID, or a question with no gold passage is refused before anything runs. The error names the offending entry and what is wrong.
The loaded corpus has an identity (for example a content digest) that changes when any passage changes and not when files are merely reordered.
A refused set produces no run record and no partial output.
Automated tests cover one valid set and at least three distinct invalid ones, and pass at the submitted revision.
The learner explains the chosen passage and question identity schemes, one rejected alternative, and what breaks first if a passage is edited after gold labels were written against it.

constraints: Standard library plus a test runner only.
No network access and no model API. Every input is synthetic and generated or checked in by the learner.
Do not implement retrieval, answering or scoring yet. This task ends at a validated, loaded corpus and question set.
Do not push to a remote or open a pull request as part of this task.

scope.description: One input boundary, its validation and its identity.

investigation_areas: What makes a passage ID stable when the corpus is edited
Which inconsistencies invalidate scores and which are harmless
What the corpus identity must be sensitive to, and what it must ignore
testing_expectations: Run the project's own test suite. State the exact command in the design; the learner chooses the runner and the layout.
documentation_requirements: Record the data formats, the identity scheme and the rejected alternative in the learner design.
